correctness.rationale: Checked gradients of the two cubic equations in characteristic 2 for smoothness, independent Kummer valuations of t,t+1,t+omega for the connected degree-27 (Z/3)^3 cover of P1, and tame Riemann--Hurwitz at four inertia-3 branch points to obtain genus10. The 13 index-three quotient lines split into 6 genus0, 4 genus1 and 3 genus2 curves; H^1 character splitting is equivariant for rational F4-defined deck actions, giving exactly 7 positive-genus L-factors. Independent GF(2^{2m}) arithmetic computed full-cover point counts N_m=9,9,63,225 at m=1..4, independently computed the seven quotient counts over F4 and F16 [3,3,9,9,7,4,4] and [21,21,9,9,31,10,10]. The elliptic/genus2 functional equation makes these data sufficient to prove the infinite zeta polynomial, not just an empirical extrapolation. The quartic characteristic polynomial z^4-z^3-3z²-4z+16 cannot factor into integral quadratics (a+b=1, ab=-11, discriminant45 nonsquare), hence simple ordinary Weil surface. The known characteristic-two Cartier result gives a-number4 and p-rank6; no new claim for those family-wide invariants.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks corroborate, but where the statement is infinite only the reconstructed analytic argument justifies the universal quantifier.
